attempts.summary: Created locked-password `opsbot` accounts on both Ubuntu 16.04 systems. Generated a legacy-compatible 2048-bit RSA key on node1, authorized it on both nodes, and verified that opsbot can run commands on node2 while password-only authentication is rejected. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs, preserved SSH access, accounts, keys, OS release, and kernel.
